Data.Responsibility:
Business Unit

What the Role Entails
Collaborate with the Art Director on the visual style of effects in the game, through verbal and written communication, concepts, or reference images/videos.
Able to demonstrate strong communication skills within and across depts.
Create optimized and performant visual effects for real-time rendering within a PBR environment using Unreal Engine.
Create weather, atmospheric, and ambient environment effects using Niagara and other Unreal tools.
Create effects required for gameplay like impact decals, explosions, muzzle flashes and other related weapons and breakable effects in using various systems in Unreal Engine.
Create Post Process, Materials, Blueprints, etc. in Unreal Engine.
Demonstrate a strong eye for lighting details, and the capability to use them in crafting top notch visual effects that support gameplay and cinematography.
Understanding of best real-time practices, pipelines and workflows.
Collaborate with Engineers and Tech Art to create and/or modify pipelines.
Troubleshoot technical and workflow issues.

Who We Look For
7+ years of VFX development experience. 
Autonomous and have the ability to communicate to get task to finish line.
Strong understanding of Unreal Engine’s tool and pipelines like Niagara, Materials, Post Process, and Blueprints.
Strong working knowledge of particle driven effects.
Strong knowledge of node-based shaders and their creation.
Experience creating realistic simulations using Houdini and other simulation packages then making them into Unreal Assets.
Strong knowledge of Photoshop and AfterEffects for texture creation.
Keen artistic eye and exceptional attention to detail.
Used to fast paced moving production and making adjustments along the way.
The capability to view visual reference of an effect, deconstruct it and then re-create it in a real-time game engine is vital.
Good understanding of and appreciation for milestones, schedules, deadlines, and efficient game development processes.
Preferred Qualifications: 
Understanding of CGFX and/or HLSL shader languages.
Texturing, modeling, skinning, animation, or lighting experience is a plus.
Substance Painter & Designer experience.
Knowledge of MEL/Python/VEX. And Houdini.

Location State(s)
US-California-Los Angeles
